releaseName: Lokify v1.4.3 – In-App Firebase Google Account Chooser & Pure Citizen Mode
releaseNotes:
• In-App Google Account Chooser: Tap Continue with Google to view and select your Google account directly in-app via Firebase without external redirects.
• Pure Citizen Mode: Fully stripped admin controls, banners, and toggles from citizen mode. Ward Officer access is now exclusively accessed via the Login screen using Email ID and Password.
• Human Figma Craftsmanship: Refined segmented control tabs, smooth elevation styling, and clean inputs.
